## Summary

Describe the user-visible contract and the root cause of the change.

## Validation

- [ ] I added or updated focused tests.
- [ ] I ran `Pkg.test()` on a supported Julia version.
- [ ] I updated docstrings, the manual, README, migration guide, or changelog as needed.
- [ ] I checked 32-bit and platform-sensitive behavior when this change uses integer widths, pointers, GMP/MPFR, or C ABI types.
- [ ] I included the complete benchmark environment header for any performance claim.
- [ ] I did not add an export without a specific user-facing reason.

## Breaking changes

State the downstream migration. Write `None` if the change is compatible.
